tagline: We believe in the transformative power of autonomous defense. Our mission is to stop attacks before they run, so every team can build without fear.

overview.description: Nexus was founded by kernel engineers and researchers who saw that humans can't out-type automated attacks. Today our team of engineers, cryptographers and data scientists builds defense that answers in microseconds.

values.name: Privacy
values.label: Core principle
values.text: Your data never leaves your kernel. All scoring happens locally.

values.name: Speed
values.label: Core principle
values.text: Threats are stopped in microseconds, with no cloud roundtrip.

values.name: Openness
values.label: Core principle
values.text: Built on open eBPF standards. No vendor lock-in, ever.

values.name: Integrity
values.label: Core principle
values.text: We are transparent and ethical in everything we operate.
